beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: As Jesus came over the hill and the whole city of Jerusalem opened up in front of him, he did something the crowds didn't expect.

timing.text: As Jesus came over the hill and the whole city of Jerusalem opened up in front of him, he did something the crowds didn't expect.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He stopped. Luke writes it in one plain sentence:

timing.text: Luke writes it in one plain sentence:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it.

timing.text: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He came close, he looked at the city, and he cried over it. Not for himself. For them.

timing.text: He came close, he looked at the city, and he cried over it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The peace they had been aching for had walked right up to their gates — and the city was too busy to see it.

timing.text: The peace they had been aching for had walked right up to their gates — and the city was too busy to see it.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.

timing.text: If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace!
but now they are hid from thine eyes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: If only you had known — even you, even today — what would have brought you peace. He is not scolding the city. He is talking to it the way you talk to someone you love who is about to walk past the one thing that would have saved them.

timing.text: If only you had known — even you, even today — what would have brought you peace.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He could see what was coming for the city he loved — armies and ruin, a generation away.

timing.text: He could see what was coming for the city he loved — armies and ruin, a generation away.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: His tears weren't anger. They were the grief of love that sees exactly what could have been.

timing.text: They were the grief of love that sees exactly what could have been.

card.text: He wept because he loved the city that couldn't see him. He sees you clearly. Don't look away.
